title: End Semester Examination Schedule Released
content: The schedule for the Odd Semester End Examinations (Nov-Dec 2024) has been published. Exams will commence from November 15, 2024. Students are advised to check the detailed timetable on the notice board and portal.

title: Diwali Holidays Announcement
content: The college will remain closed from October 29, 2024, to November 3, 2024, on account of the Diwali festival. Classes will resume on November 4, 2024. Hostellers can leave the campus starting October 28 evening.

title: Deadline for Even Semester Fee Payment
content: This is to inform all students that the last date for paying the Even Semester fees without a late fine is December 15, 2024. Please ensure timely payment to avoid penalties.

title: Annual Cultural Fest 'Tarang 2025'
content: The annual cultural fest 'Tarang 2025' is scheduled for February 20-22, 2025. Students interested in volunteering or participating in events should register with their respective cultural secretaries by January 15, 2025.

title: TCS Campus Placement Drive
content: TCS will be visiting our campus for the Ninja and Digital hiring process on January 25, 2025. All eligible final-year B.Tech students must attend the pre-placement talk in the main auditorium at 9:00 AM.

title: Workshop on Applied Machine Learning
content: The Computer Science department is organizing a 2-day workshop on 'Applied Machine Learning using Python' on March 5-6, 2025. Registration fee is Rs. 200. Limited seats available.

title: Annual Sports Meet 'Spardha'
content: The intra-college sports meet 'Spardha' will be held from March 15 to March 18, 2025. Department sports captains should submit their team lists by March 1, 2025.

title: Extended Library Timings during Exams
content: In view of the upcoming end-semester examinations, the central library will remain open until 10:00 PM on weekdays and until 6:00 PM on weekends, starting April 15, 2025.

title: Health Advisory: Monsoon Precautions
content: With the onset of the monsoon, students are advised to drink only boiled or RO water. The campus medical center has stocked up on essential medicines. Report any symptoms of fever immediately.

title: Declaration of Even Semester Results
content: The results for the Even Semester Examinations held in May 2025 will be declared on July 10, 2025. Students can check their results on the student portal using their enrollment numbers.
